name: 2026 deploy: mean(extratrees, xgb) tuned on all 17 gamedays (walk-forward, official points)
evidence: Honest estimate (same family/structure tuned on odd 2026 gamedays, scored on the 8 even ones, leak-free panel): driver RMSE 14.62 vs simulator 15.22 (-0.60, 95% CI -1.26..+0.05), vs simulator+form 15.12, vs previous best 15.01; pick-5 value 0.79 vs 0.71. Constructors derived (c_sim 0): RMSE ~20.6 vs simulator 22.0-22.2 on both halves. Decisions: planning blend 0.5 model + 0.3 simulator + 0.2 form played the 2026 season best walk-forward (4151 = 72% of the 5741 optimum; model alone 3953, simulator+form 3955, simulator 3330) - in-sample, one season. Seeds: 5 per family averaged (even gamedays 14.621 vs single-seed mean 14.624, -0.001 [-0.027, +0.022]; a single seed moves a driver forecast by ~0.3 pts and two seeds share 4.82 of their top 5 on average - averaging removes that luck from decisions).
